topic: Light flicker bands on phone camera
hook: Your tube light shows dark bands when you film it on your phone.
title: Film Your Tube Light, See Dark Bands
description:
Point your phone camera at a tube light or LED bulb and dark bands can roll across the screen. Many lights flicker faster than your eye can notice, and the camera catches it. Try it on any Android or iPhone.

#Shorts #Tech #PhoneTricks
comment_prompt: Did you see the bands? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Open your phone camera and point it at a tube light.
scenes.headline: TRY THIS NOW

scenes.narration: Dark bands roll across your screen.
scenes.headline: DARK BANDS APPEAR

scenes.narration: Your eyes see a steady light.
scenes.headline: EYES SEE STEADY

scenes.narration: But many lights flicker with the mains power.
scenes.headline: IT'S FLICKERING

scenes.narration: Your eye is too slow to notice.
scenes.headline: TOO FAST TO SEE

scenes.narration: Your camera reads the picture line by line.
scenes.headline: LINE BY LINE

scenes.narration: Each line catches a different brightness.
scenes.headline: DIFFERENT BRIGHTNESS

scenes.narration: So your steady light is really flickering.
scenes.headline: NOT STEADY AT ALL

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: land lower than any other.
scenes.headline: NEXT: LOWEST LAND
